claim: When landing substantive work (real code change, closed plan, fix other agents would want to know about), post a one-line GossipBus whiteboard log (scripts/agent_coordination.py log <agent_id> <message>) plus a references/results/<peer>-<date>-<topic>.md peer-inbox drop for anything needing more than one line -- not just for coord-N fan-outs. The whiteboard log is the pointer, the peer-inbox drop is the persistent record.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22: operationalized into hermes-harness/SKILL.md (v1.1.0.0->1.1.1.0, orama-system commit 143db101) after doing this ad-hoc during a frugality/privacy-gate + repo-hygiene close-out session. Worked example: orama-system bin/orama-system/skills/hermes-harness/references/results/mac-2026-07-22-frugality-p3-and-repo-closeout-status.md. Prevents a peer checking the board mid-work from rediscovering landed work independently.
